findings.evidence: Line 80 supplies `[Field F]` to the entire file; lines 92–443 use only inversion, left scalar row operations, and division-ring linear algebra, while the field-specific `Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row` occurs only at lines 460–466.
findings.fix: State the algorithm and non-rank correctness under `[DivisionRing F] [DecidableEq F]`; introduce `[Field F]` only around `rank_rowReduceMatrix` and `length_rowReduce_ofFn`, whose Mathlib rank lemmas require a field.
findings.issue: The global `[Field F]` makes `rowReduceStep`, `rowReduce`, the invariant, echelon correctness, and span preservation unavailable over division rings, although their operations and proofs require no commutativity.

summary: The file-wide `Field` assumption unnecessarily restricts the algorithm and nearly all correctness results to commutative division rings.
